changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[AssetsByTypeUserCantRead] ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select AssetID from ResponsibilitySummary where ResourceId = @ResourceID and AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and [Permissions] & 1 = 0 union all select A.ID as AssetID from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID and T.ID = @AssetTypeID where T.DefaultPermissions = 0 and not exists(select 1 from reporting.Global_Resource where ResourceID = @ResourceID and IsAdministrator = 1) and not exists(select 1 from ResponsibilitySummary where AssetID = A.ID and ResourceID = @ResourceID) and not exists(select 1 from ResponsibilitySummary where ApplyToType = 1 and AssetTypeID = T.ID and ResourceID = @ResourceID) )
